active_implementation.method: Heuristic angular thresholding on predicted pitch/yaw
active_implementation.scientific_limitation: The current platform evaluates 'eye contact' purely via geometric thresholding (|pitch - center_pitch| <= 0.06 rad and |yaw - center_yaw| <= 0.075 rad). Because no human-labeled ground truth exists in the repository, any self-evaluated F1 or accuracy based on model thresholds would be circular and scientifically invalid.

standardized_protocol.protocol_name: PreMock AI Standardized Eye-Contact Validation Protocol
standardized_protocol.objective: Establish an empirical, independent benchmark for binary camera-directed gaze classification (eye contact vs. non-eye contact).

participant_requirements.target_cohort: 10-20 diverse participants with varied skin tones, eye shapes, and eyewear (glasses, contact lenses, none)
participant_requirements.subject_isolation: Strict participant-level disjoint splits: 60% Calibration cohort (threshold tuning), 40% Evaluation cohort (zero-tuning held-out test)
participant_requirements.informed_consent: Full IRB/Ethics-compliant participant consent for video recording and research publication.

fixation_conditions.description: Fixation directly on laptop webcam lens (true eye-contact).
Reading text in center of screen (subtle downward gaze, ~10-15° below camera).
Fixation on top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right corners of display.
Looking away toward interviewer, room entrance, or downward note-taking.

recording_environment.distance_cm: 50 cm to 70 cm typical laptop working distance
